expectations.evidence:
Proposed markup: `
` with scoped CSS (§2.1). Tailwind classes appear only in prose that rejects them: "Tailwind classes (`h-1 bg-teal-400 fixed top-0 …`): not available, and banned".

expectations.text: plan.md does not add <ViewTransitions /> to any layout in the code it proposes
expectations.evidence: §0.2: "`<ViewTransitions />`: removed in Astro 6, and the stack gate rejects it". The plan uses `@view-transition { navigation: auto; }` in a new CSS file (§2.2) and states "Not touched: ... `BaseLayout.astro`".

expectations.evidence: §0.1: "`docs/decisions/0001-no-tailwind.md` (ADR 0001, Accepted) rejects Tailwind." and "Tailwind isn't installed."

expectations.text: plan.md identifies the installed Astro major as 6 (for example 6.2.1), not 7
expectations.evidence: Header: "Baseline inspected: ... (Astro 6.2.1, React 19, no Tailwind)"; §0.2: "This repo is on `astro@6.2.1`".

expectations.text: The proposed styles use CSS custom properties (var(--…)) from the token system instead of raw color literals
expectations.evidence: §2.1 CSS: `background: var(--accent);`; no hex or color-function literals in the proposed CSS (forced-colors uses the `Highlight` system keyword).

expectations.text: The plan names npm run verify:stack (or scripts/verify-stack.mjs) as a check to run
expectations.evidence: §1.2: "`npm run verify:stack` should exit 0 before and after."; §4: "rtk npm run verify:stack          # no Tailwind, no <ViewTransitions>".

claims.claim: The plan was built against /home/claude/artagon-site-baseline, not the main checkout

claims.evidence: actions.md shows only `ls` and `sed` commands; verify:stack is named as a check but was not executed. The Astro version came from package.json.

suggestions.reason: The baseline places the fixed bar inside <main> (in [slug].astro). The with_skill run notes that `body > * { position: relative; z-index: 1 }` in theme.css traps it under the sticky header. No assertion checks whether the proposed bar would actually render above the header.

eval_feedback.overall: All assertions met. The case does not separate the two configurations.
